A position tolerance and a speed tolerance are the two error bounds the adaptive stepper is asked to hold simultaneously; neither is integrated to reach the other, and the producer's own control happens to move both together because one slider drives two indices.

PrincipiaPlanIntegratorArgs.lengthTolera.reason: The request half of the same pair, and the same answer. See `PrincipiaPlanIntegrator.lengthToleranceMetres`.

PrincipiaPlannedBurn.finalMassTons.reason: The mass flow IS the derivative of the mass, so the pairing is real, but this is the END of the integration rather than its start: integrating forward from the mass at cutoff describes a burn that is already over. The rule has the direction backwards here, and the field it should have proposed is the initial mass beside it.

PrincipiaPlannedBurn.initialMassTons.reason: Real, and already integrated by the producer: mass flow is the rate of mass, and the plan carries the answer as `finalMassTons`, so a reckoning here would re-derive a number the wire already holds and disagree with it whenever the burn is throttled. Worth modelling only for the mass PARTWAY through a burn in progress, which nothing asks for yet.

Rp1BuildItemEntry.timeLeftSeconds.reason: Dimensional degeneracy, the same case as CareerStrategy.dateActivated: `divide({s:1},{s:1})` is `{}`, so EVERY dimensionless field is the dimensional rate of EVERY time field in its own type. TrajectoryForceModel.stepSeconds.reason: Dimensional degeneracy again: `ratio` is dimensionless, so it reads as the per-second rate of every time field in its own type.
